coverage_questions: The paper does not provide exact task-specific input formats for all seven Stage 1 representation-learning branches, so their internal branch construction remains opaque.

The Stage 4 description is internally inconsistent: the figure describes final GNN and agent-LoRA training, while the Methods text describes Stage 4 as producing a final merged checkpoint. Exact ordering and merge operands are unresolved.
The exact Qwen tokenizer invocation, special-token placement, masks, teacher-forcing inputs, and hidden-state extraction details are not documented.

The internal OCellus Transformer Encoder, data-integration/alignment mechanism, graph convolution, LayerNorm, activation, dropout, and MLP internals remain opaque where the paper does not establish their tensor algebra.
The exact OCellus-Agent tokenizer, JSON parsing implementation, tool argument serialization, expert input representations, verifier predicates, and retry-state representation are not documented.
The paper documents gene-symbol embedding extraction by averaging last-layer hidden states, but the catalog has no operation for hidden-state extraction followed by token-axis averaging.
The exact per-tool verification, rejection, retry, and warning-state serialization in the single-cell workflow is not documented.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Averaging last-layer hidden states over tokens to produce fixed-length per-gene embeddings.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has projection, reshaping, and lookup, but none represents hidden-state extraction followed by token-axis averaging.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Graph convolution over STRING protein-interaction edges with LayerNorm, rectified-linear activation, dropout, and subsequent message passing.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has attention, projection, and indexed update operations but no graph-neighborhood message-passing primitive.

operation_proposals.source_operation: EvenClock geometric neighbor search, median-neighbor-distance normalization, angular/radial sector assignment, and tie handling.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: No single catalog operation represents cKDTree neighbor search combined with coordinate-scale normalization and geometric sector assignment.
